}}'''Dalaine Ndaye''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|36}}.

==History==
She was the first Amyrlin not of the [[Green Ajah|Green]]-[[Blue Ajah|Blue]]-[[White Ajah|White]] axis since [[Bonwhin Meraighdin]] - a period of 179 years.

Dalaine held the position for twenty-eight years until her death in {{Ne|64}}. She was [[Rabayn Marushta]]'s successor and [[Edarna Noregovna]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was a weak Amyrlin.
